messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: GPU node pool 'gpu-pool-prod' approaching max node limit (98/100). Autoscaler attempted scale but max_nodes reached. Queues growing. Paging oncall.

matt (oncall): seeing lots of pending pods in kube-scheduler, backpressure on request queue. Can folks drop cluster-level logs?

sara: attaching recent HPA/autoscaler events: `FailedScaleUp: reached max nodes` and `ScaleUpNotAllowed: nodeGroup at max`. Also spike in 4 customers' request rates.

kevin: logs: `pod pending: Insufficient nodes with gpu=true` across multiple AZs. GPU pool is saturated, other node pools are cpu-only.

julia: customers impacted: acct-112, acct-314, acct-987 — high latency and 429s for batch infer calls. CS already got a few alerts.

matt (oncall): immediate mitigation options? fallback to CPU variants, or manual cap raise. Which is fastest?

sara: fallback will help some but model quality drops; we should do short-term manual cap bump on node pool to relieve queue while infra works on long-term scaling policy.

kevin: I can request a manual node limit increase in cloud console, but need ops approval and an estimate for capacity. Current max=100, set to 140? that should clear backlog for ~30m.

julia: Approve manual bump to 140 for 1 hour. Notify finance afterwards. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: @matt please confirm 2FA and infra tickets for manual change.

matt (oncall): confirming, proceeding. I'll open an infra change and apply the cap.

matt (oncall): running helper command:
```
# infractl (internal)
infractl nodepool update --cluster prod-cluster --pool gpu-pool-prod --max-nodes 140 --reason "incident: unblock queues"
```

incident-bot: New incident ticket created: INC-2021001. Link: https://redwood.inc/INC-2021001

kevin: kicked the change through. Cloud console shows target max 140. Autoscaler should now be allowed to add nodes. Watching for scale events.

sara: scale up events starting: +12 nodes requested, provisioning...

matt (oncall): monitoring pending pods: count went from 180 -> 40 in ~6m. CPU fallback lanes still available if needed.

customer-success: pinged affected customers with status update and ETA ~15-25m to full recovery. Keeping oncall in thread for questions.

kevin: note — we hit a cluster-level kubelet registration delay in us-west1-b earlier; provisioning may be slower; estimate 10-20m to be fully effective.

julia: tracking SLO impact: customer latency target breached for acct-112 and acct-314 for 14m. Logging this for postmortem and notification.

matt (oncall): once nodes are ready, we'll drain backlog via autoscaler. Post-facto actions: (1) increase default max_nodes for gpu-pool to 150, (2) update autoscaler policy to allow quicker burst, (3) evaluate cross-region routing for burst.

kevin: I'll file infra task for permanent policy change. Also adding a guardrail to avoid runaway cost: schedule autoscaler to revert to 100 after 60m unless ops-marked.

incident-bot: ACTIONS: manual-cap-bump applied -> 100 -> 140, infra ticket filed, CS notified, oncall handoff in 2h if still ongoing.

matt (oncall): handing off to kevin for monitoring. I'm off for a quick break; leave notifications on.

kevin: taking over monitoring. If queue not cleared in 30m we flip partial traffic to fallback region and open emergency reclaim.

ops-bot: reminder: please update the incident doc with timeline and command snippets.

customer-success: will send final customer update once queue < 10 and error rate back to normal.

kevin: current metrics: pending pods 28, avg latency returning to baseline for 2/3 customers, 429s halved.

julia: saving notes for postmortem: root cause likely combined traffic spike + autoscaler conservative burst limits + hard max_nodes. Recommend runbook tweak.

matt (oncall): thanks all — great coordination. Keeping thread archived under INC-2021001.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: queue drained, autoscaler operating within new cap. Manual cap will auto-revert in 60m per policy.

kevin: closing monitoring window, will follow up with infra PR and postmortem draft.

customer-success: customers notified: all acknowledged.

matt (oncall): handoff complete -> next oncall is sara in 2h. Good job. :clap:
